L’As du Fallafel is a lively, always-buzzing spot in the Marais and easily one of the most popular street food stops in Paris.  We tried the chicken shawarma, lamb and turkey shawarma, along with their house hot sauce, fries, and an Israeli beer. Everything hit the mark—the wraps were packed, juicy, and easily among the best we’ve had anywhere. The chicken shawarma in particular stood out for its flavor and freshness, while the hot sauce added a great kick without overpowering the food. The fries were simple but satisfying and worked perfectly alongside the wraps.  The atmosphere is fast-paced and energetic, with a constant mix of locals and tourists, and it’s usually packed, which adds to the experience. Service was friendly despite the crowds and the quick turnover.  A must-visit for anyone craving a generous, flavorful, and satisfying falafel or shawarma experience in Paris.

I’ve been here twice, with my first visit being around 10 years ago, when the place was much smaller and operating more like a simple food stand. I remember being quite impressed with the food back then, especially the falafel. Recently, I decided to come back and try it again, this time with a group of eight people.  It was interesting to see how much the place has changed over the years. They have expanded and now have another space across from the original location with a proper seating area, which makes it much more comfortable if you want to sit down and enjoy your meal rather than just grab something quickly.  Overall, our experience was good. The food quality was decent, the service was friendly, and the restaurant was clean, organized, and comfortable. The staff treated us well, especially considering that we were a relatively large group of eight.  Of course, we tried the falafel, which is what this place is mainly known for. It was good, although I have to say that I remember the quality being better when I visited about 10 years ago. Maybe my expectations were higher because of my first experience, but this time it didn’t impress me quite as much. That being said, it was still enjoyable and certainly not disappointing.  We also tried their pasta, and I was pleasantly surprised. The pasta was nicely prepared and the quality was good. It was a nice alternative to the falafel and something worth considering if you’re visiting with a group and not everyone wants the same thing.  I wouldn’t describe this as an extraordinary or must-have dining experience, but everything was consistently good: good food, good service, a clean environment, and a relaxed atmosphere. Sometimes that’s exactly what you want from a casual restaurant.  Considering how long they have been around and how they have grown from a small stand into a larger establishment with seating, they are clearly doing something right. If you are in the area and looking for a casual meal, I think it is definitely worth trying at least once, especially for the falafel.

L’As du Fallafel is a true Parisian institution and, without a doubt, one of the best places to enjoy an authentic falafel. Everything is incredibly fresh, flavorful, and generously prepared. Be aware that it is almost always packed, so come prepared to wait—and remember to be patient and kind to the hardworking staff. An iconic address in the Marais that is absolutely worth experiencing!

On informe le serveur, avant de commander, que nous voulons 4 factures séparées, il nous fait la morale comme quoi il n’y a pas de problème tout en ne comprenant pas pourquoi nous ressentons le besoin de le préciser.  Au moment de recevoir les plats, les assiettes sont garrochées un peu partout sur la table. Moi et mon ami nous regardons parce que nous trouvons cette facon de faire très expéditive, le serveur nous a vus et est revenu se justifier.  Lors du paiement, le serveur nous remet une seule facture et nous précise que le tip n’est pas inclus, mais qu’il est fortement recommandé. Avec le service que nous venions de recevoir, cette demande était manifestement inappropriée.  Le plus décevant n’est pas seulement le mauvais service, mais surtout l’impression que la satisfaction de leurs clients ne semblait pas être une priorité. Aucun effort n’a été fait pour   répondre à nos simples demandes de façon professionnelle.  Dommage car la nourriture était bonne, mais cela ne compense pas l’exécrable service reçu du serveur!  Au final, je n’y retournerais pas et les prix sont élevés pour les portions!
